label: Deep refresh across all criteria (13 Nov 2026), including AI-generated works
description: Multi-language sweep across every catalog topic, 13 Nov 2026, plus a dedicated search for AI-generated films, shorts, vertical/micro dramas, YouTube/TikTok/Bilibili/Douyin series, AI anime, and AI comics/webtoons. Focus on titles new since the 12 Nov 2026 deep refresh, plus vertical dramas and non-English works. Adults only; non-explicit notes; every entry sourced with a confidence label. AI-generated works are marked in format/meta and tagged AI-generated. This file was created at the start of the run so the weekly routine can see the refresh is in progress.

records.title: 人付き合いが苦手な未亡人の雪女さんと呪いの指輪
records.meta: TV anime · Japan · Japanese · late-night broadcast; a separate 18+ streaming edition was also released · original story by ぷぅ崎ぷぅ奈 · directed by 古賀一臣 · animation by studio HōKIBOSHI / 彗星社
records.character: 雪乃深冬 (Yukino Mifuyu, a yuki-onna widow who lost her husband two years earlier and lives alone); 高橋さとる (Takahashi Satoru, human owner-manager of a youkai apartment building)
records.summary: In a present-day world where humans and youkai live side by side, apartment manager Satoru angers Mifuyu, the widowed snow woman he is attracted to. Hoping to make peace, he uses a mysterious ring said to make communication with youkai easier; instead Mifuyu becomes extremely forward with him, and the ring repeatedly draws the two of them together.
records.hypnotist: A cursed ring used by Satoru; the effect on Mifuyu is unintended
records.evidence: The official site identifies Mifuyu as a widow of two years and states that a ring advertised as easing communication with youkai instead makes her pursue Satoru; the director's official comment notes a separate 18+ streaming edition. Suiseisha's Value-Press release and Oricon's 2026 autumn-anime listing confirm the TV broadcast.

records.title: Mum, I'm Alien Pregnant
records.meta: Film · New Zealand · English · comedy-horror · 95 min · directed by THUNDERLIPS (Māhutonga) · starring Hannah Lynch, Yvette Parsons and Arlo Green · produced with XYZ Films · premiered in Sundance's Midnight section · New Zealand rating R16
records.character: A millennial underachiever living with her mother (Hannah Lynch) who becomes accidentally alien-pregnant; her mother; the baby's father (described as a 'useless baby-daddy')
records.summary: A messy millennial underachiever accidentally becomes pregnant with an accelerated extraterrestrial, parasitic pregnancy. She has to deal with sceptical doctors, the baby's father, and her oversharing mother in order to survive and reclaim her life.
records.hypnotist: None described — the threat is a parasitic alien pregnancy, not hypnosis
records.evidence: The official XYZ Films page states that a messy millennial underachiever accidentally gets alien-pregnant and must survive sceptical doctors, a useless baby-daddy, and her oversharing mum. NZIFF confirms the 95-minute running time, the New Zealand R16 rating, the Sundance Midnight premiere, and describes the story as exploring the pitfalls of hosting a parasitic life form. Event Cinemas New Zealand also lists the title and R16 rating.
